# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.42

RX Profile Sync update dated 2026-07-30.

## Added

- Master administrators can search for a specific active RX record and compare its Pharmacy, Patient Transport, and Pharmacy Transport assignments to its linked Patient profile.
- The administrator selects individual fields to copy; every change is recorded in RX History and Audit Log.

## Safety

- No database migration, workflow-action configuration, or automatic bulk synchronization.
- Deleted RX and Patient records are excluded. An empty field selection makes no change.
- Validate on the test server before any production update.
